Partner with Our Speciality Coffee Roastery

We’ve established a state-of-the-art speciality coffee roastery and are seeking new clients to experience our premium coffee. Our focus on quality at every step of the roasting process ensures a high-calibre, consistent product. If you believe our coffee would complement your business, we’d love to hear from you. Please fill out the form below, and we’ll get in touch promptly.

We work closely with a number of green bean imports to offer a range of truly exceptional coffees at Strangers. We are committed to working with importers that focus on quality and transparency with their sourcing methods knowing a fair price has been paid to the farmers. In return for this we get to roast and sell some of the best coffee from around the world.

Origin

We are sent samples from the importers we use based on our criteria and what we’re looking to showcase. We then roast it on our sample roaster to get a good understanding of the flavours before committing to buying quantities of the green beans. Once we have selected an exceptional coffee and we have a basic understanding of the flavours, we profile it on our main coffee roaster followed by our after roast quality control. We sample batches of coffee to make sure we are completely happy with it as well as taking colour readings and checking the solubility to make sure we are consistent with our roasting. Once it has passed all of its checks we are happy to sell the coffee ready for customers to brew.
